author: GamingBolt
description:
If the games on this rundown prove one thing, it's that vigilantism comes in all kinds of flavours: lone saboteurs, immoral detectives, figures with ethical codes which fold when the world demands. 

Across genres, showcased here are the fifteen best vigilante games: exploring that vital tension between justice and obsession, demonstrating just how far someone will go to right the wrongs of corruption, criminality, stolen freedom, or a failed system.
title: 15 Games That Let You Play As A Vigilante Fighting Crime From The Shadows

author: GamingBolt
description:
Code Vein is often labeled the first true “anime Souls” game, but what really made it unique went beyond its art style. This video breaks down how Code Vein reimagined the Soulslike formula through deep character customization, a highly flexible build system, and a focus on overt storytelling and party-based gameplay. 

From its lore-rich Blood Code system to its emotionally charged memory sequences and striking music, Code Vein weaves its narrative and gameplay mechanics beautifully. 

Years later, the game stands out as a successful experiment showing another side of the Soulslike formula that few games have managed to embrace.
title: What Made Code Vein One Hell of A Game?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Resident Evil 7 remains one of its most defining modern entries, and it's the game that put the premier survival horror offerings back on the map after the horrendous failure of Resident Evil 6. 

With this video, we try to revisit the game not from a historical perspective, but as a standalone survival horror experience while pitting it against modern contemporaries that have come out since. 

We will be discussing about Resident Evil 7's intimate first-person perspective, restrained storytelling, deliberate combat, and oppressive atmosphere and how it holds up today. 

From the haunting Baker Mansion and its unforgettable antagonists to the game’s excellent pacing, sound design, and brutal survival mechanics. This video breaks down why Resident Evil 7 is still the king.
title: Resident Evil 7 Review - 9 Years Later, The Baker House Still Hits Hard
